# 如何免费获得外链

- 作者：Flavio Amiel（@fba）
- 原帖发布时间：2026-09-12 04:07（北京时间）
- 原帖：https://x.com/fba/status/2098503799044243554
- 收藏日期：2026-10-29
- 英文标题：How to get backlinks for free.

## 中文全文

![Image](<../../90_附件/FBA/HR9hljYawAAHepp.jpg>)

好吧，这个结果确实令人印象深刻。

今年 5 月，我为一位客户制作了这份内容资产。

4 个月后，它获得了：

- 20 条外链
- 其中 3 条来自域名评级（DR）超过 45 的网站
- 还有 2 条来自 DR 高达 82 的网站

为了获得这些外链，我一封陌生开发邮件都没发。

这不是偶然走运，而是一套‘机制’。

今天，我就把它究竟如何运作讲清楚。一旦看懂，你就再也无法忽视它了。之后，我还会告诉你，怎样让人帮你做出这样的内容资产。

![Image](<../../90_附件/FBA/HR9Sb52bIAArgD8.jpg>)

2 条 DR 82 的外链，再加 18 条细分领域相关外链，全部免费？你没听错吧！

你看，如今整个互联网都靠引用他人的工作来运转。

每篇博客、每位记者、每个 SaaS 落地页，以及现在的每一个 AI 回答，都需要一个数字来支撑自己的说法。

- ‘这个市场价值 $$$。’
- ‘已经有 Y% 的团队在这样做。’

那么，怎样让自己成为这些说法的出处？成为第一个提供那个数字的可信来源，并且做到：

- 数据结构清晰
- 可以直接引用
- 标明日期

做到这些的企业，就能获得外链。

成为信息来源之后，你还会被 ChatGPT、Google AI Overviews 和 Perplexity 引用。你会成为整个主题下的默认答案。

聪明的投入方式，就是做出所有人都不得不引用的东西。

我把它称为‘引用中心’策略（Citation Hub）。

下面就是它的运作机制。

![Image](<../../90_附件/FBA/HR9Sk91bQAAYVGm.png>)

我的一位客户获得了所有这些免费外链，网站权威也在不断累积。

逐步拆解这套机制

1. 选择一个让人不得不引用资料的核心词。

我们不用‘最佳会计软件’，而用‘2026 年会计行业统计数据’。

想象一下，一位作者要为明天发布的文章找一个统计数字，晚上 11 点输入了这条查询。这样的查询有很强的引用意图，而且需求长期存在。

接着，为每个章节和子章节做关键词研究，直到把这个主题覆盖得面面俱到。你永远不知道人们具体会查什么。

2. 汇总 50+ 条统计数据，只使用第一手来源。

这是所有人最容易做错的一步：他们直接从其他汇总文章里抄数字。

但你必须把每一条统计数据都追溯到真正产生它的机构或材料：政府部门、财报文件，或者原始研究。

有时，这也意味着要越过付费墙。随后，我们会核实每个 URL 都能打开，而且那个数字确实出现在该页面上。

为什么这很重要？记者在链接到你之前，会沿着引用追溯到原始出处；但只要你把事情做好，最终就能占据优势。

3. 设计页面结构，让它适合被引用，而不只是适合阅读。

- 在顶部放一个‘核心要点’区块，列出 10–14 条可以直接引用的统计数据，每条一行。
- 使用问句式标题，精确对应 AI 拆解查询时产生的子问题，并在标题下的第一句话就回答问题。
- 每条统计数据都标注发布者、日期和链接。每个数字只出现一次，事实之间不夹杂废话。

4. 标明最新日期，并持续维护。

新鲜度既是排名信号，也是引用信号：即便是一张已经停止更新的 2026 年统计页面，也会比 2023 年的页面更受青睐。

就这么简单。

不需要私有博客网络（PBN），不需要链接农场，尤其不需要四处求人。

只要做出这个细分领域最值得引用的内容资产，外链和 AI 提及就会主动找上门来。

效果证据

以下是我们制作的 5 个页面，从 5 月到 8 月的数据：

- 这些页面累计获得 80+ 条外链。
- 其中 10 条来自 DR 60+ 的网站，这类链接通常每条要花几百才能买到。
- 一个页面独自获得了 20 条链接：单个内容资产，完成了整场外链推广活动的工作。
- 约 40% 的锚文本就是统计数据本身。人们直接引用我们的数字，例如‘$10.87B 的市场’、‘56% 的工资溢价’、‘95% 的准确率’。每一条经过核实的统计数据，都是未来可能被别人引用的切入点。
- 外链还在持续累积：页面获得关注后，单月又新增了 23 条。

我第一次这样做是在 2023 年。我们当时为那家公司制作的其中一份内容资产，现在已经有 300+ 条外链。

## 英文原文

Ok, this is impressive.

Last May I built this Content Asset for a client.

Four months later it had

- 20 backlinks
- Three backlinks over Domain Rating (DR) 45
- And two backlinks sitting at a DR of 82

I sent zero cold emails to get them.

This isn’t a fluke but a "mechanism".

And today I’m going to show you exactly how it works, because once you see it you can’t unsee it (and then I’ll tell you how to get one built for you.)

![Image](<../../90_附件/FBA/HR9Sb52bIAArgD8.jpg>)

2x 82 DR BACKLINKS + 18 NICHE RELEVANT, FOR FREE? SAY WHAAA

You see, the entire internet runs now on citing other people's work.

Every blog post, every journalist, every SaaS landing page, and now every AI answer needs a number to back up its claim.

- “The market is worth $$$.”
- “Y% of teams already do this.”

And how do you make yourself be the claim? Be the first credible source that has the number:

- structured data
- ready to cite
- dated

The businesses that do this, those get the link.

And by being the source you also get cited inside ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, and Perplexity. You become becomes the default answer for an entire topic.

The smart money is building the thing everyone has to cite.

I call it the Citation Hub tactic.

Here’s the mechanism.​

![Image](<../../90_附件/FBA/HR9Sk91bQAAYVGm.png>)

one of my clients getting all these free backlinks and compounding authority

The mechanism, step by step

1. Pick the head term people are forced to cite.

We don't use “best accounting software”, but “Accounting statistics 2026”.

The query a writer types at 11pm when they need a stat for the post they’re publishing tomorrow: this has a high citation intent with permanent demand.

Then keyword-research every section and sub-section until you've covered the topic wall to wall. You never know what people will look for.

2. Aggregate 50+ statistics (from primary sources only.)

This is the part everyone gets wrong: they copy numbers off other roundups.

But you have to trace every single stat back to the entity that actually produced it: the government body, the earnings filing, the original research study.

Sometimes this means hopping over the paywalls as well. Then we verify every URL loads and the number is really on that page.

Why it matters: journalists trace citations to the root before they link to you, but if you do things well, you'll end up on top.

3. Structure the page to be cited, not just read.

- A Key Takeaways block up top: 10-14 one-line, quotable stats.
- Question-style headings that match the exact sub-questions AI breaks a query into, each answered in the first sentence underneath.
- Every stat attributed to its publisher, with a date and a link. Each number appears once and no fluff between the facts.

4. Stamp it fresh and keep it alive.

Freshness is a ranking and a citation signal: a dead stats page from 2026 gets taken over a 2023 one.

That’s it.

No PBNs, nor link farms, and specially: no begging.

You build the most citable asset in the niche, and the links and AI mentions come to you.

The proof

The data from five pages we built, May to August:

- 80+ backlinks earned across the pages.
- 10 links from DR 60+ sites — the kind you’d normally pay hundreds each for.
- One page pulled 20 links on its own — a single asset doing the work of a full link campaign.
- ~40% of the anchors were the statistic itself — people literally quoting our numbers (“$10.87B market,” “56% wage premium,” “95% accuracy”). Every verified stat is a hook someone will eventually cite.
- And the links kept compounding: 23 new ones landed in a single month once the page had traction.

The first time I did this was 2023. And that business has over 300+ backlinks to one of the assets we built for them.
